decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans AB-HOU-215-001 Rev B and Design and Access Statement received 7th October 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for a bingo hall and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 9am to 11pm Monday to Saturday and 10am to 10.30pm on Sunday.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a bingo hall shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 8 - No refuse generated by the use hereby approved shall be stored other than within the building prior to collection and removal from the site except with the prior written approval of the local planning authority achieved through the submission of details pursuant to this condition.
description: Change of use from a Bank (Use Class A2) to a licenced Bingo hall (Use Class D2)
